blockingLoop.evidence: Please leave the doors closed for a day to allow the appliance to settle at its new temperature setting.

rationale: The customer asked four times what to set the dial to and never got an answer. The assistant kept repeating the same questions about settings and fast-freeze, and twice told them to wait a day for a 'new setting' that had never been given. It did correctly point to food blocking the vent, but it never told the customer to move the food or set the dial to a mid setting, so there was no real progress. It was safe and recommended no part, but it was not useful.
